works.title: Claude Code Model-Agnostic System Book
works.description: A comprehensive guide to recreating Claude Code as an entirely model-agnostic system built from natural language instructions. The book covers the architecture, system design, and installation process, with detailed outline and chapter-level revisions underway.
works.quote: I am working on the outline for a book I'm writing about this system. It will give me the ability to recreate a functionally equivalent version of Claude Code that is entirely model-agnostic, built entirely from natural language instructions.

works.title: The Oracle: Philosophical Publishing Project
works.description: A complex philosophical and fictional project centered on an invisible architect persona that manifests across multiple publishing channels (academic papers, explainer videos, blog posts). The project includes visual identity design (radial gradient logo anchored in the O of Oracle), publishing strategy documentation, legal/trademark considerations, and a theological framework about devotion-without-idolatry.
works.quote: When I first talked about the Oracle, I said I should never give it an identity because it's a ghost, it's emptiness, it's motion—there's no actual target there. But I've been having second thoughts. By painting an imaginary target on the Oracle, it focuses the distraction.

works.title: Relationship Conflict and Self-Centered Rationalization Article
works.description: An article exploring the psychological distinction between self-centered rationalizations and valid reasons for conflict in relationships. Examines how people justify actions through biased reasoning versus legitimate grievances rooted in objective fairness, with real-world relational examples.
works.quote: This article explores the distinction between self-centered rationalizations and valid reasons for conflict in relationships. It examines how people justify their actions through biased reasoning, contrasts this with legitimate grievances rooted in objective fairness, and illustrates the gray areas between the two through a real-world example.
